# Mads Hartmann's Blog

> Writing about software engineering, reliability, observability, and developer tools.

Pages are available as Markdown using the links below, or by requesting their HTML URLs with `Accept: text/markdown`. Markdown and HTML are generated from the same published content.

## Content

- [All posts](https://blog.mads-hartmann.com/index.md): Chronological archive with links to every published post.
- [Journey into Observability](https://blog.mads-hartmann.com/series/observability.md): A series on observability tools and practices.
- [Book reviews](https://blog.mads-hartmann.com/book-reviews.md): Index of book reviews.
- [Conference talks](https://blog.mads-hartmann.com/talks.md): Talk descriptions and recordings.

## Related sites

- [Mads Hartmann](https://www.mads-hartmann.com/llms.txt): Software engineer and tech lead focused on reliability. Biography, experience, education, and publications.
